title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. Bought this to clean urine from one berber carpet and one nylon just a few weeks ago.  I used it the weekend after it arrived.  Did a nice job on the nylon carpet.  The berber ...left an aweful smell - musty and mildewy.  I read FAQ's and said that the carpet may need more than one cleaning if that smell happens as the first loosened up the dirt.  I redid the carpet two more times with no luck.  I have had to remove that carpet and I have it outside hoping the rain we are getting and some intense natural sunlight will kill the odor.  If not, I will need to buy a new carpet and I would like to charge Bissell for it.  I also find it goes through a ton of water. I got maybe only two 10 feet passes and had to refill the tank - and solution.  That solution is pretty expensive to go through that much for one cleaning.  Then by the third cleaning, the suction got super slow.  I never did see the brushes rolling even from the first time.  I was thinking they were going so fast it just looked that way and with the water flushing through it is hard to tell but now I am sure the brushes don't roll.  I looked at videos this morning and will check all their suggestions when I have time (although I already did a thorough cleaning of it) and see if that helps but man am I tired of buying products that lead you to have to give up more time (I work several jobs and time is a premium) to fix them, like checking out this website for problem solving and then pulling apart the darn thing to actually try to fix it.  I wish I could charge these companies for the time i have to give up to  take care of these kinds of things.  Products should not have problems right out of the box.
